synthesis.paragraph: The paper "A directional latent demand index for city links: from mobility traces to service gaps" shares 4 references with the paper "Theory-informed and interpretable graph learning for urban commuting flows" published on 2026-06-14, including "Understanding individual human mobility patterns", "A universal model for mobility and migration patterns", and "A Family of Spatial Interaction Models, and Associated Developments". Additionally, "Analysis of travel activity patterns and charging choices of BEV users in Japan" shares 3 references with the 2026-06-14 paper "Data-driven analysis of EV public charging station demand across heterogeneous built environment", specifically "Fast-charging station choice behavior among battery electric vehicle users", "Understanding the generation mechanism of BEV drivers' charging demand: An exploration of the relationship between charging choice and complexity of trip chaining patterns", and "Electric vehicle users' charging behavior: A review of influential factors, methods and modeling approaches". Over the last 30 days, the University of Hong Kong has appeared on 5 papers, Hong Kong Polytechnic University has appeared on 4 papers, and both Southwest Jiaotong University and the National University of Singapore have appeared on 3 papers.
